### `ef_write_page`

_Source: `lib/ext_flash/ext_flash.h`_

```cpp
e_syserr_t ef_write_page(uint32_t addr, uint8_t *data, uint32_t len);
```

Write data to the W25Qxx (page program, up to 256 bytes).

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `addr` | Address to write to. |
| `data` | Pointer to source array. |
| `len` | Length of data in bytes (max 256). |

**Returns:** Error code.

### `ef_write_rom`

_Source: `lib/ext_flash/ext_flash.h`_

```cpp

```

Write generic ROM data to the W25Qxx.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `rom` | ROM data to write. |

**Returns:** Error code.

> **Note:** Only use this if you know what you are doing! This violates the "RO" in "ROM"!
